scenes.text: Hello little friend! I'm Funny Bunny, and I'm so excited to see you today. We're going to hop into a wonderful adventure all about friendship. Are you ready to learn and have fun together? Friendship is like having a buddy to share your carrots with. Let's discover what makes a good friend and how we can be one too. Get your bunny ears ready, because here we go!

Now, do you remember the last time you played with a friend? Friends are those special people who make us laugh and feel happy inside. They are the ones who help us when we fall down and cheer us up when we're sad. It's important to have friends, because they make every day brighter and more fun. Just like how a rainbow needs all its colors, we need friends to make our days colorful. So, let's talk about how to make new friends!

To make new friends, we need to be friendly and kind. That means smiling, saying hello, and asking if someone wants to play. When you see someone playing alone, you can ask, 'Do you want to join us?' It's like inviting someone to a big, fun bunny party! Being a good listener is also important, so we can understand what our friends like and feel. Let's practice asking a friend to play, can you say, 'Would you like to play with me?' Great job!

Now that we've learned how to ask someone to play, let's try to be brave and do it together. Imagine we're at the playground, and there's a new bunny sitting by themselves. We can hop over and say, 'Hi, I'm Funny Bunny, would you like to play?' Remember, it's okay if they say no, because sometimes bunnies just need a little time. But trying is what makes us brave and friendly. You're doing wonderful, keep it up!

Remember when we talked about being a good listener? Listening helps us understand how our friends feel. If a friend says, 'I'm sad,' we can ask, 'What can I do to help?' Helping friends feel better is a superpower we all have. Sometimes just being there and giving a hug is all they need. Let's practice, can you pretend to give me a big bunny hug? Wonderful, you have the biggest heart!

Sharing is another important part of friendship. When we share, it shows we care about our friends' happiness. It could be sharing toys, or even our favorite snacks. Imagine you have a carrot, and your friend has an apple. If you both share, you get to taste something new and delicious! Let's say together, 'Sharing is caring!' You did it, you're a sharing superstar!

Now let's talk about playing fair. Playing fair means everyone gets a turn and follows the rules. This helps everyone have fun and feel included. If we're playing a game and someone wins, we say, 'Great job!' and clap our bunny paws. And if we win, we can say, 'Thank you for playing with me!' It makes everyone feel happy and excited to play again. You're learning so much about being a great friend!

Let's try a fun activity together. Think of your favorite game, and imagine inviting a friend to play with you. Now, let's count to three and say, 'Let's play together!' One, two, three, let's play together! Wasn't that fun? Practicing these words makes it easier to say them when we're with our friends. You're doing such a fantastic job, I can see your friendship skills growing!

Remember when we talked about kindness? Kindness is like magic, it makes everyone feel special. We can be kind by saying nice things like, 'You're a good friend,' or 'I like playing with you.' It's also about helping, like picking up toys after playing. Kindness makes our hearts happy and our friendships strong. Can you think of a way to be kind to your friend today? I bet you have lots of great ideas!

Have you ever wondered what makes someone a best friend? A best friend is someone who always makes you smile and is there for you no matter what. They know your favorite games and remember your birthday. Do you have a best friend or someone you like to play with the most? It's okay if you don't have one yet, because making friends takes time. Let's keep learning how to be a great friend together!

Let's talk about trust in friendships. Trust means believing your friend will be there for you and keep their promises. It's like when you lend a toy, you trust they'll take care of it. In return, we should also be trustworthy friends. When we say we'll do something, like meet at the playground, we make sure to be there. Trust makes friendships strong and lasting, just like a sturdy tree. You're doing so well learning about being a trustworthy friend!

Sometimes friends have disagreements, and that's okay. It's important to talk about our feelings and listen to each other. If a friend is upset, we can say, 'I'm sorry, let's fix it together.' And if we're upset, we can say, 'Can we talk about it?' Solving problems together makes friendships stronger. Let's practice saying, 'I'm sorry,' and 'Let's talk,' to help us be ready for any situation. You're a problem-solving pro!

Now, let's have a little fun. Imagine we're at a big bunny picnic with all our friends. There's a game of tag, a basket of carrots, and lots of laughter. Can you see it? Picture yourself running and playing with your friends, feeling happy and free. Friendship is like that picnic, full of joy and shared moments. You're doing amazing, and I'm so proud of you for learning about friendship!

Well, my little friend, our friendship adventure is coming to an end. But remember, the lessons we've learned will always stay with us. Being a good friend means being kind, sharing, and listening. It means playing fair, being trustworthy, and solving problems together. I'm so proud of you for being such a great learner today. Until next time, keep spreading your friendship magic everywhere you go. Goodbye, and see you soon!
